        <div>
          <h3>II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics</h3>
          <p class="entry__where">CUNEF Universidad, Madrid</p>
          <p>A single-track meeting of seven keynote lectures and five contributed sessions, covering model selection, Bayesian computation, spatial and temporal modelling, financial econometrics, adversarial and robust machine learning, and applied Bayesian methods. Organised with CUNEF Universidad and funded by SEIO and CUNEF Universidad; registration was free of charge. The closing session announced the winner of the Mar&iacute;a Eugenia Castellanos Award.</p>

          <p class="entry__where">Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, Puerta de Toledo campus</p>
          <p>The first edition brought together 37 participants for 17 talks.</p>

              <p><strong>Invited speakers.</strong> Mar&iacute;a Eugenia Castellanos (Universidad Rey Juan Carlos), David Conesa (Universitat de Val&egrave;ncia), Gonzalo Garc&iacute;a-Donato (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha), Rosario Susi (Universidad Complutense de Madrid) and Pilar Gargallo (Universidad de Zaragoza).</p>
